solopreneur.faqTitle: A few things you might ask.
solopreneur.faqOneQuestion: Does Maetry work if I work alone?
solopreneur.faqOneAnswer: Yes. Set up your services, working hours and online booking for a single professional. You don't need a team to get started.
solopreneur.faqTwoQuestion: What can I see before signing up?
solopreneur.faqTwoAnswer: During setup, enter your services and working hours and open a preview of your online booking page. Then continue with registration and business setup.
solopreneur.faqThreeQuestion: How do clients book with me?
solopreneur.faqThreeAnswer: Share the link to your booking page. Your client chooses a service and an available time, then completes the booking confirmation.
solopreneur.faqFourQuestion: Can I accept payments and deposits?
solopreneur.faqFourAnswer: Maetry supports connecting Stripe and Square. Payment and deposit availability depends on your region, provider and business settings.
solopreneur.faqFiveQuestion: Where can I see the price?
solopreneur.faqFiveAnswer: Plans are available on the pricing page. You can review them before setting up your own booking page.
solopreneur.finalDescription: Set up your services and hours. See what your clients will see. Continue when you're ready.
